pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of grid/basket pyramiding within 15 points of an active drawdown; subsequent entries require a proven +$10 floating cushion on the primary ticket.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero order execution during high-impact structural price velocity spikes; require a 3-bar consolidation pattern and volume confirmation prior to trigger.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate trailing stop-lock or partial harvest dynamically when unrealized profit reaches +$12.00 to prevent evaporation of gains.
